<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916418_theRebbe_902" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916418_theRebbe_902__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the date and time of the completion of the Sefer Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Friday, Erev Shabbat Kodesh, Parshat Bo,</t>
    <t s="2">the 10th of Shevat,</t>
    <t s="3">after midday,</t>
    <t s="4">5730 (1970).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section states that this was the completion of a Sefer Torah for the reception of Moshiach Tzidkeinu.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">– The completion of the writing of a Sefer Torah for the reception of Moshiach Tzidkeinu –</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the writing was initiated and stirred by the Rebbe, the Nasi of our generation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">– Which he stirred and began its writing – before the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Nasi of our generation –</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
